title: Gandhi Pirantha Mann
desc: Balu, determined to honour his late parents' fight against caste discrimination, takes on the oppressive forces led by Rukmani's father, seeking justice and striving for social reform.

title: Vivaramana Aalu
desc: A robber abandons his wife for a wealthy woman, but soon regrets his decision. Later, he returns, vowing to win back her trust and prove his love.

title: Gokulathil Seethai
desc: Son of a wealthy man Rishi leads a carefree lifestyle. However, his life begins to change when he meets Nila, a college student, and gradually falls in love with her.

title: Garjanai
desc: Upon discovering a criminal network headed by another doctor, an upright medical practitioner vows to reveal the shocking truth.

title: Chanakya
desc: Arjun, a highly sought-after RAW agent, is known for his skills at catching some of the most hardened criminals. However, he falls in danger when he goes after Ibrahim Qureshi, a terrorist.
